Government of the People's Republic of B: The Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh, through the Ministry of Finance, acts as the issuing authority for this regulatory notification.
Ministry of Finance: The Ministry of Finance serves as the overarching administrative ministry responsible for the issuance of this customs-related notification.
Internal Resources Division: The Internal Resources Division, functioning under the Ministry of Finance, is the specific government body responsible for the administration and notification of customs and value-added tax matters.

Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of this Act empowers the Government to amend customs notifications in the public interest and in consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(1) of this Act is cited as one of the legal authorities enabling the Government to issue this amendment.
National Board of Revenue: The Government consults with this body before issuing notifications or amendments related to customs duties and tax concessions.
S.R.O. 37-AIN/2011: This existing notification is formally amended by the present order through the replacement of its attached schedule.
TABLE: This table replaces the previous list of items and their associated H.S. Codes in the specified notification.
